# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [George](../character/george.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a small boy with a dark, sullen face. He has black eyes that can convey hostile, curious, or mocking expressions.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye is a sullen, mischievous boy with a notably impertinent demeanor. He harbors a clear dislike for female teachers, holding the belief that they are not any good.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## History

Anthony Pye was an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes), and her husband. As a sullen student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's instruction, he eventually placed a mouse in Anne's desk. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) whipped him for the prank, Anthony began treating her with new respect, having ultimately approved of the punishment.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony Pye is a student in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's schoolroom. Their relationship undergoes a shift after Anthony puts a mouse in Anne's desk during a chaotic school day, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to whip him. Though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is initially heartbroken over losing her temper, the discipline earns her Anthony's new respect and approval.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), +3 more_
